rules.label: Disallowed category
rules.message: This category is not eligible for reimbursement under IRAS Regulations 26/27. Talk to finance if you believe this is a special case.

rules.label: Future-dated claim
rules.message: The expense date is in the future — submit again after the expense actually happens.

rules.label: Missing receipt over S$50
rules.message: A receipt image is required for claims above S$50.

rules.label: Small meal — within allowance
rules.message: Within the standard meal allowance — no manager review needed.

rules.label: Local transport — within allowance
rules.message: Within the local transport allowance — no manager review needed.

rules.label: Above auto-approve ceiling
rules.message: Above the auto-approval ceiling of S$500 — manager review required.
